title: Brand New: GUI
body:
# IMPORTANT!
This texture pack is **not** expected to receive new updates.

Due to my personal life and lack of motivation to keep working on texture packs, I decided to put all my projects in a uncertain hiatus. Making these packs became more of a chore than anything fun, I enjoy the process of making the textures and models, but I dislike the technical side, bugs, etc. It's just not **my** thing, I prefer doing other stuff.

If I get enough motivation and free time I might come back and update it, but for now, don't expect anything new anytime soon.

### You can see other things I do here:
[My socials](https://dhudizi.carrd.co/)
